briefing.headline: FRMI rockets 42% overnight as token spikes, while mega‑cap tech slides
briefing.summary: The overnight session was dominated by a broad sell‑off across the core mega‑cap tech names and the major indices, with eight of the ten core stocks down and the SPY falling 0.42%. Only a few outliers bucked the trend – FRMI jumped 42% and SNDQ rose 18.5%, while MSFT and META managed modest gains. The breadth was narrow, indicating a risk‑off tone ahead of the US open. Traders should watch for continued pressure on the technology sector unless fresh catalyst emerges.
